item.description: The Oscar-winning actor died Sunday at age 95.

item.title: Injured seabird desperately pecks at hospital door for help
item.description: The black cormorant had a triple fishing hook stuck in its beak.

item.title: CU Boulder Student Government calls on Big 12 to equitably enforce fan conduct policy
item.description: The University of Colorado Boulder's Student Government has passed a resolution urging the Big 12 Conference to apply its fan conduct policies equitably after the conference has inconsistently reprimanded different universities for the same anti-Mormon chants shouted by fans during football games this fall.

item.title: Monarch hockey hosts Heritage in 5A’s opening round
item.description: The Coyotes (10-8-1) won five of their final six regular-season games to secure the No. 7 seed in the 5A bracket and a home start in the playoffs against the 10th-seeded Eagles at the Sports Stable on Saturday at 7 p.m.

item.title: Opening statements held in the trial of a Georgia high school shooting suspect’s father
item.description: Prosecutors say he gave his son access to a gun and ammunition despite warning signs.

item.title: Cuban drivers face monthslong wait for gasoline in a government app designed to reduce lines
item.description: Fuels shortages and blackouts have been intensifying in Cuba this month.

item.title: Buffaloes’ women’s basketball team finding rhythm on offense
item.description: Offensively, this is not the most prolific team that JR Payne has had during her time in Colorado. Lately, however, the CU women’s basketball team has found some rhythm on offense and will look to continue that on Tuesday at Arizona.
